notes.title: Farlands Journey is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Embark on an epic adventure through mysterious lands, uncover hidden secrets, and face thrilling challenges. The journey begins today![/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585951/73350877feda61abfd75d02edc0b6fef786bf245.png"][/img][/h2][h3][b]10% discount on start![/b][/h3][p]Don't miss the opportunity to buy the game at a bargain price.
And also don't forget to leave a review about our game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]12 completely different locations[/p][/*][*][p]8 types of enemies and 4 bosses[/p][/*][*][p]11 hats that give different special abilities[/p][/*][*][p]8 types of magic wands[/p][/*][*][p]many secret places[/p][/*][*][p]aesthetics of graphics and music from 8-16-bit consoles[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Let the adventure begin![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585951/9c5cf07cc2163f671652c09fcdb7cde07d94b1a4.png"][/img][/p]
